summary: Assess BAS and IoT risks, plan OT segmentation and practise facility incident response. Explore the five-day course and its practical outputs.
lede: Smart building cybersecurity focuses on identifying risks to connected building systems and planning safeguards that limit disruption to building services. For security, facilities, real estate and OT/IT professionals, the course develops practical skills in mapping BAS assets and data flows, assessing facility risks, segmenting networks, reviewing vendor access, and planning incident response and recovery.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for protecting connected buildings, operating facilities or managing real estate technology risk. It suits people who need to coordinate building operations with IT and security controls.
modules: BAS Asset Discovery and Data Flows
prerequisites: Working familiarity with building operations, IT networking or security operations is expected. No programming is required. Experience with BAS or OT environments is useful but not essential.
